recipes.name: Spiced Rum Tarte Tatin
instructions: Peel and quarter Granny Smith apples. Set aside. - 4 Granny Smith apples peeled & quartered
Combine the sugar and water in a medium sauce pot over low heat to begin, until the sugar becomes clear, about 1 minute. - 250 g granulated sugar - 1 tbsp water
Then, increase the heat to medium low, and pay careful attention to the color. Stir or whisk occasionally as the mixture begins to brown and caramelize.
Finally, add the rum, and carefully flambée until the flames subside and the alcohol smell has dissipated. - 1 ½ tsp rum to taste

Transfer the caramel mixture to a large sauté pan followed by the apples, and stir to ensure an even coating of caramel. Cook for about 5-8 minutes over medium heat to release their moisture. - Caramel - 4 Granny Smith apples peeled & quartered - For the Caramel
Arrange the cooked apples in a greased cast iron skillet and drizzle with the remaining caramel. - Caramel - 4 Granny Smith apples peeled & quartered - butter for greasing
Top the cast iron skillet with puff pastry trimmed to size and poke many holes about a half-inch apart to allow steam to escape. - puff pastry (store bought or homemade)
Bake at 350°F for about 25 minutes or until a light golden crust forms.
While the Tarte Tatin bakes, make homemade vanilla whipped cream.
Combine all ingredients in a chilled mixing bowl and whisk vigorously until medium peaks form. - ½ cup heavy cream - 2 tbsp powdered sugar - 1 tsp pure vanilla extract
Once the Tarte is finished baking, carefully invert the pan onto a plate, patching the dessert up as necessary.
Serve warm with fresh vanilla whipped cream! - Vanilla Whipped Cream - For the Vanilla Whipped Cream
